semanticChecks.method: Field-by-field author self-review of both Chinese translations against Japanese source only; no peer texts read.
semanticChecks.coverage: Full translations of titles, paragraphs, prompts, glossary entries and two illustration alt texts. No summarization.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndNegations: Retained distinction between common products and unique project conditions; requirements vs implementation, test coverage vs individual result, budget vs component cost, planned/incurred/paid expense, preceding completion vs next-stage acceptance, and activity vs confirmed outcome.
semanticChecks.uncertainty: Preserved not-necessarily statements on site conditions, subsequent work starting early, documents revealing all instructions and prior-day usability. Preserved all unreceived/unconfirmed/under-investigation states.
semanticChecks.numbers: Both occurrences of source 5M preserved per locale. All ASCII number token multisets checked per source field. Japanese written counts translated as written Chinese counts.
semanticChecks.technicalTerms: Checked single-piece production,5M resource factors,design documents,as-built shapes/dimensions,material lots and samples,hidden works,cost categories,schedule links,environment monitoring,work interfaces,career card versus licenses,and layout reference axes/elevations/main ink lines/calibration.
semanticChecks.finalCorrections: Changed license wording to 执照/執照 to avoid confusion with work permits. Changed start-of-work inspection wording to 作业前/作業前 to preserve recurring daily applicability instead of implying only initial project commencement.
semanticChecks.sourceOnlyScope: No independent legal thresholds, acceptance values, test frequencies, emergency steps or additional safety procedures introduced.

limitations: Author self-review only; no independent native-speaker or engineering approval.
